tasks.label: Pytest: Repository Integration Tests
tasks.command: docker stop dynamodb-local-test redis-test >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; docker run -d --name dynamodb-local-test --rm -p 8000:8000 amazon/dynamodb-local && docker run -d --name redis-test --rm -p 6379:6379 dhi.io/redis:8-debian-dev redis-server --protected-mode no && sleep 2 && uv run pytest --run-repo; EXIT_CODE=$?; docker stop dynamodb-local-test redis-test; exit $EXIT_CODE

tasks.label: Pytest: All Integration Tests
tasks.command: docker stop dynamodb-local-test redis-test >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; docker run -d --name dynamodb-local-test --rm -p 8000:8000 amazon/dynamodb-local && docker run -d --name redis-test --rm -p 6379:6379 dhi.io/redis:8-debian-dev redis-server --protected-mode no && sleep 2 && uv run pytest --run-repo --run-provider; EXIT_CODE=$?; docker stop dynamodb-local-test redis-test; exit $EXIT_CODE
